caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented wooden signboard suspended by two dark metal hooks from the top corners. The signboard has a decorative, symmetrical wooden frame with curved and pointed extensions at the top and bottom. Within the wooden frame, there is a rectangular green background. At the center of the green area, there is a wood-textured shield outlined in yellow-gold. The interior of the shield contains fine linework of a tree and possibly other decorative elements, with some faded or lightly inscribed text. Beneath the shield, there is a horizontal dark band with the word "EMMAUS" inscribed in capital letters. The primary colors in the drawing are muted grayish-brown for the wood, green for the sign's background, and yellow-gold outlining the shield, while the hooks and inscription have a dark, nearly black color. The drawing is on a plain, cream-colored background.
title: Tavern Sign
